cues: Four bases read in threes give four cubed, sixty four codons.
Sixty one code for amino acids, and three, U A A, U A G and U G A, mean stop.
A U G means start, and methionine.
The code is triplet, non overlapping and comma less.
It is degenerate: most amino acids have several codons.
It is unambiguous, and almost universal, the same in bacteria, in rice and in you.
